title: Set page processing
description: Set the form processing that runs when one of this workspace's form pages is submitted.

page.description: Action key of the page, as list_catalog lists it under pages. Example: student_new.

audience.description: Which audience's page carries that action key.

x-enum-descriptions.member: The page signed-in members fill in.
x-enum-descriptions.public: The page anonymous visitors fill in.

processing.description: Name of form processing this workspace has (list_catalog lists them under processing), or of the shared "Save page record".
